messages:
Aisha (Marketing): Draft 5 uploaded: https://drive.redwood/drafts/dedicated-launch-v5.md — needs a quick pass for canonical/og + final CTAs.
Tom (Content): reading now. big picture: love the narrative but headline variants feel long. propose A/B test two headlines on publish: short vs descriptive.
Tom (Content): Variant A: 'Reduce LLM Latency and Cost with Dedicated Inference'
Tom (Content): Variant B: 'How Product Teams Cut Latency & Token Cost with Redwood Dedicated'
Eve (Design): OG image options are in the assets folder. OG-2 is cleaner. alt text set to: "abstracted inference topology over server room".
Marco (Growth): For tracking, use UTMs: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=dedicated_launch&utm_term=headlineA (or headlineB). Also we should append gclid for paid later.
Marco (Growth): HubSpot form id needed for webinar vs demo routing. Which form do we use?
Aisha (Marketing): Use the product-interest form for demo, webinar-signup form for webinar. I'll insert both CTAs in the post body.
Noah (Product): accuracy check: paragraph 2 refers to "model offloading" 1 that phrase is ambiguous. Suggest "memory offloading for KV cache".
Sana (Legal): privacy/legal: reword the telemetry line. Current: "we never look at customer prompts." Suggest: "Redwood does not access customer request payloads except to provide the service, support the customer when explicitly authorized, or as required by law."
Aisha (Marketing): updated draft with legal wording.
Tom (Content): also removed passive voice in the benchmark section. added a short bullets list for key wins.
Eve (Design): uploaded OG-2.jpg and mobile-safe crop OG-2_small.jpg.
Marco (Growth): webhook mapping for forms:
```
form: webinar-signup
fields: {email, first_name, company}
utm_source -> utm_source
campaign_tag: dedicated_launch
route: marketing_webinar_queue
```
Marco (Growth): We'll route demo form to sales_inbound if intent_score >= 60.
Aisha (Marketing): SEO: propose slug /blog/dedicated-inference-case-study. Thoughts?
Tom (Content): shorter slug is fine. prefer playbook vs case-study? playbook might rank better. open to consensus.
Noah (Product): playbook sounds actionable. go with /blog/dedicated-inference-playbook.
Aisha (Marketing): ok slug locked. Tom will set canonical tag to /blog/dedicated-inference-playbook and add rel=alternate for A/B headlines.
Sana (Legal): one more: remove customer quote that mentions specific customer names unless we have permission.
Aisha (Marketing): removed names and replaced with anonymized attribution.
Tom (Content): final checklist: H1, meta desc, OG image, canonical, twitter card, schema article. I'll add meta copy in the doc.
Eve (Design): quick QA: ensure OG-2_small meets 1200x630 for FB/Twitter. I checked.
Marco (Growth): schedule: canary publish Wed 09:00 PST -> monitor 2 hours -> full push 11:00. Is that ok?
Aisha (Marketing): timeline works. need an engineer on-call for 9-11 in case of embed/form problems.
Noah (Product): I'll be available 8:45-11:15.
Eve (Design): I'll standby 8:30-10:30 for any visual tweaks.
Sana (Legal): I'm good with the updated privacy + quote edits. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Scheduled publish job created for 2026-03-25T09:00:00-07:00 (job id: publish-179005).
Aisha (Marketing): final call 1 approvals? :raised_hands:
Tom (Content): :+1: from me.
Noah (Product): :thumbsup:
Marco (Growth): :rocket:
Eve (Design): :thumbsup:
Sana (Legal): Approved.
Aisha (Marketing): Great, closing this thread. I'll post the final link in #product-updates once live.
